name: Le Sereno Hotel St. Barths
positioning: Intimate beachfront resort on the Grand Cul De Sac in St. Barths, known for contemporary design and understated luxury service, with suites and private villas
best_for: Travelers who want an intimate beachfront stay on the Grand Cul De Sac
Families or groups who want a multi-bedroom villa with its own heated pool and kitchen

facts.text: Le Sereno is a St. Barths hotel located on the waters of the Grand Cul De Sac.
The resort is known for its contemporary design.
The resort is known for its understated luxury service.
Suite categories include the Grand Suite Plage, the Grand Suite Plage Sud and the Bungalow Piscine.
The hotel has its own spa, Le Sereno Spa.
Each Le Sereno Villa has three to four bedrooms, a fully equipped kitchen and expansive terraces.
The villas have a wood-paneled library with a media room and a surround-sound large-screen home theater.
The villa kitchens have aluminum Schiffini cabinets by Vico Magistretti.

highlights.text: Le Sereno is an intimate beachfront resort.
Each Le Sereno Villa has a heated private pool overlooking the Grand Cul-de-Sac.
Each Le Sereno Villa offers more than 7,000 square feet of indoor and outdoor space in half an acre of private landscaped garden.
The villas have a large covered terrace with a panoramic ocean view, a dining table and a lounge.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing that reflects the hotel's exclusive positioning.
WhataHotel notes that the remote island location requires flight connections.
